result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For most small companies, **I'd recommend Gusto or BambooHR**, depending on whether you need payroll or a more complete HR management system.

If you're a US-based company with roughly 5–100 employees, these are the platforms I'd shortlist for 2026.

## Best HR software for small businesses

![Gusto Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ftD0qJ1yBSoWTtDEs2sOfDQ7-65e7zEzHy-HIAb3bqFrmNGGc0DyUX0E7CdY1ulVg_3Q5_8qLVi4LE1wqaQS_JVEpU9pxbwM6Kz6OYgPCcQM2vYw21WPy-MCNW4IYnmmdNSrLtuLoIyJLYtPy5hO5B7jEV7698TKyyKP6yzFWMR7Sgf2P81H8Y7V-Tx23IPn?purpose=fullsize)

(Best for most small businesses)

**1\. Gusto**

Best for payroll, onboarding, benefits, tax filings, and basic HR in one system.

- Starting price: \$49/month + \$6/employee
- Easy to use
- Strong payroll automation
- Good for companies without dedicated HR staff

[Gusto website](https://gusto.com/)

---

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

(Best overall HR management)

**2\. BambooHR**

Best for managing employees, onboarding, PTO, performance reviews, and employee records.

- Starting pricing varies; small-company pricing can start around \$250/month
- Excellent employee database
- Good reporting and onboarding
- Payroll is an additional offering

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![Rippling Company Profile Funding & Investors | YourStory](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SAzMvIL6PtbUMLb8gBTabCeVnrSEXbTwCT-aC0SC4jJFQ74dXv0idEYA-gW8Xf4QyVq2JUnFjv2iQman7uk3D8kUDVp4a4whGwY7X8hxbhcNKKU6eqdr0HQC44Yinb10-d1Qx8pYpUGPKlk3izjNGAFETr0jiBpGuRO01GQ7GCiUG98Lat9yOYtjvREa50cA?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

Best for companies that want HR, payroll, IT, employee devices, and software access managed together.

- Starting pricing around \$8/employee/month plus base fees
- Powerful automation
- Great for growing companies
- More complex setup and pricing

[Rippling website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

Best budget-friendly HR management.

- Free entry-level plan available
- Paid plans start around \$1.50/user/month
- PTO, attendance, employee records
- Payroll requires separate software

[Zoho People website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

![Justworks Logo & Brand Assets (SVG, PNG and vector) - Brandfetch](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Io68a1rZIYqghBFnpokHIj1x3GRQ90PTJ6fdn3t8C7qcNJugj4Q9VvkgzzpPxiWw3tFdPF1tFCYZ2TRZC-sUEDBpMJb1lp5Gj9R-1FOsVbc-u5hYKm8pN18IiyksTK--QfY917VOeTQuOZRX5z9aH80sazGY4TNWBk4RxbvSR78aDAZ53uZ8bV4JFwoZ5JnO?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Justworks**

Best for small companies that want more HR support, benefits administration, and help with compliance.

- PEO and payroll services
- Benefits administration
- Access to HR support
- Generally more expensive than standalone HR software

[Justworks website](https://www.justworks.com/)

These recommendations are consistent with recent 2026 software comparisons. ## My recommendation by company size

| Company size | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| 1–10 employees | Gusto or Zoho People |
| 10–25 employees | Gusto or BambooHR |
| 25–50 employees | BambooHR or Rippling |
| 50–100 employees | BambooHR or Rippling |
| Growing internationally | Rippling or Deel |


## What I'd look for in an HR system

Regardless of which platform you choose, I'd prioritize\:

- Employee records and document storage
- Digital onboarding and e-signatures
- PTO and vacation tracking
- Performance reviews
- Employee handbook and policy acknowledgments
- Payroll and benefits integration
- Time and attendance tracking
- HR reporting and compliance support

## Let me narrow it down to the best one for your company.

One important question: **How many employees does your company currently have?**

I'd also like to know whether you're primarily looking for\:

- An HR system to manage employees, onboarding, PTO, and performance.
- Payroll plus HR in one platform.
- A complete HR department solution, including compliance, policies, and employee management.

With those details, I can recommend the best two or three options and compare their actual costs.
